title: COMPARE — HB_MEASUREMENTS table
description: Array of donor records. One element is one donor in the haemoglobin measurements taken at donation (Hb_measurements sheet): the Haemospect, Hemocue and Orsense dates and values. A blank in the provider's data is written as null; the dictionary's own codes are kept as constants.
$comment: Category files are wired into allOf as each category is converted. JSON Schema cannot enforce uniqueness of rows across the table; the identifier's format and whether the other tables carry it are open questions for the data provider (D009).
